declared_comparison.note: MAE comparison permits the declared three-decimal rounding (<=0.000501). Exact, under, over and failure fields must match exactly.

checks.description: white/东风商用车 claim lies in upper band while foreground white vehicle is below
checks.conclusion: Count 4 does not prove object-box-attribute binding. This is also a stable overcount across all three runs, not evidence of correct objects.

checks.description: count=4 but the farthest roof color claim is unsupported by visible evidence
checks.conclusion: A correct total does not verify a deterministic color claim. Without an attribute gold set, no color accuracy rate is reported.

checks.description: same OCR string appears on two distinct vehicle records in every run
checks.conclusion: Duplicate text is an identity/OCR risk, not proof that both readings are wrong. It cannot be used as a unique instance key.

checks.description: r1 exact total does not represent three-run stability
checks.conclusion: Report all runs 5/4/3. Do not select r1 after seeing the truth.

counterexamples.scope_note: Machine checks verify published fields and geometry claims; semantic support still requires the cited images. No counterexample changes a label.
